_comment: Manual video id fixes, applied after resolution and recorded at confidence 1.0 so no automated match can overwrite them. Keyed by 'title | film' as it appears in the catalogue. Add an entry whenever a song plays the wrong recording.

Ek Anar Do Bimar | Baazi.note: Resolver matched a web series episode of the same name (Bakkbenchers). The commonly cited upload for the real song has embedding disabled; this one is the Kalyanji-Anandji Classics copy and does embed.

Aap Ke Kamre Mein | Yaadon Ki Baaraat.note: Re-resolution replaced a correct Saregama Music upload with a trap mix of the same song from Saregama Mix Station. The rules now reject reworkings, but this restores the exact upload that was there before.

Aankhon Aankhon Mein | Aankhon Aankhon M.note: Was pointing at a T-Series upload titled 'Ankhon Ankhon Mein' that is a different recording. This is the 'Kishore Kumar - Topic' upload, generated by YouTube from the rights holder's own audio. Note the catalogue holds three songs with near-identical names — this is the Kishore/Asha duet whose film shares its title, not the Mahal song and not the Brian Silas instrumental.

Aa Dil Se Dil Mila Le | Navrang.note: Resolver matched the 2007 Naqaab song of the same name (Tips Official, Pritam) instead of the 1959 Navrang song by Asha Bhosle. Reported with a link whose embedding is disabled (oEmbed 401); this is the Shemaroo Filmi Gaane upload of the same recording, which does embed.
